manifest.name: V4-gdn-q4k
manifest.description: All GDN projections as Q4_K fitted from BF16. SparkInfer's own A/B of a Q4_K refit of NVFP4 measured +19-23% decode; a fit from BF16 avoids the double quantization it paid for.

execution.packed_wide: NVFP4 if free VRAM at load > payload + 3 GiB, else Q4_K(nvfp4)
